html:
Question 4
?

Let A={−1,1} and consider the relation "is not equal to" (≠) on A. Which of the following sets describes the relation?

a
{(−1,−1),(−1,1),(1,−1),(1,1)}
b
{(−1,1)}
c
{(−1,1),(1,−1)}
d
{(−1,1),(1,−1),(1,1)}
e
{(−1,−1),(1,1)}
Submit
